subobjective.stem: Name six things in and around the school, in Yoruba.
Count from ogún down to ọ̀kan in Yoruba.
Name five foods of the Yoruba home and one soup.
Say four greetings with the time they are used.
Mention five animals a Yoruba home keeps.

Give six opposite word pairs in Yoruba.

points: Ọmọ tó mọ ìyá rẹ̀ lójú
Ìyá ọwọ́, bàbá ọwọ́ — honour to parents

theory.stem: Name the things round the school in Yoruba and write two sentences on your classroom.
